note: 8-call window Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27; all eight transcripts opened from ir.zaggle.in (links filed on NSE/BSE), plus Q4 FY24 transcript for Rule 7 and the Q4 FY26 investor presentation for outcomes. Grading conventions: one item per commitment, graded at its first statement; upward revisions graded as fresh, stricter items; downward revisions inside the period scored against the original (C5.3). Item grades averaged per call. Score: fixed slot weights 8->1 newest first; Q1 FY27 and Q4 FY26 pending (material items open) and excluded; graded Q3 FY26 1.67x6, Q2 FY26 1.50x5, Q1 FY26 0.67x4, Q4 FY25 1.00x3, Q3 FY25 1.00x2, Q2 FY25 2.00x1; sum(grade x weight) = 27.20; sum(weight) = 21; score = 27.20/(42) x 10 = 6.5. Sensitivity: grading Q4 FY26 at 2.0 on its two closed minor items gives 7.4. Pattern: revenue guidance beaten every year (FY25 68% vs 45-55%; FY26 42.2% vs 35-40%); margin, Propel-margin, cash-flow and acquisition-timing promises repeatedly missed; long-run margin target diluted from 15-16% in 4 years to 14-15% in 5-7 years; FY27 EBITDA guidance refused twice (C5.4 applies). Major-issue (Severe) override test: no item meets it - misses are delivery shortfalls, not unreliable numbers; the capitalisation-policy review with auditors (Q1 FY27 p.12-13) and CFO exit of 3-Apr-2026 are context for the forensic battery, not grounds to override here.
